title: MoE aux_loss accumulated twice with activation checkpointing
root_cause: MoE layer recompute re-runs forward without no_grad, calling save_to_aux_losses_tracker() twice per step. The aux_loss contribution is doubled.
invariant: save_to_aux_losses_tracker() must be called exactly once per (step, layer, loss_name)
fixed_behavior: training completes with 1 call per step/layer
notes: Trace diff (cksum comparison) cannot detect this bug — the parameter impact is too small in short training

expected_output.buggy: BUG DETECTED: 6 violations (aux_loss called 2x per step)
